info.title: XChain Explorer API
info.description:
Read-only REST API for the XChain Platform: tokens, balances, actions, markets, smart contracts, staking, attestations, and state checkpoints on Bitcoin, Litecoin, and Dogecoin.

Conventions: `coin` is the host chain, `tick` is a token symbol (there is no "asset" field). Amounts are arbitrary-precision decimal strings, and so are chain indices (`block_index`, `action_index`, `checkpoint_seq`, `snapshot_block`) on both the REST and WebSocket surfaces: they compare byte-for-byte across endpoints and stay exact above 2^53. List responses are `{total, data: [...]}` with `page`/`limit`/`sortorder` query parameters (limit max 100; balances/holders max 500). Errors are `{error: "message", code: "STABLE_CODE"}`. See the error-code registry at https://docs.xchain.io/protocol/Error_Codes.md. A WebSocket API lives at /{COIN}/api/websocket. See https://docs.xchain.io/components/explorer/WEBSOCKET.md.

LLM-friendly docs: https://docs.xchain.io/llms.txt

parameters.name: action

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Pipe-delimited action parameters, exactly as encoded on the wire. Over a GET the practical ceiling is the HTTP request-line limit (~16 KiB including headers), not this one: POST the body for anything larger, such as a multi-hundred-command BATCH

parameters.name: feeMode
parameters.description: How the transaction being composed will settle the protocol fee. The verdict differs: `xchain` debits the payer XCHAIN balance, `native` pays a coin output to the fee destination. Omit it to get the chain default (native on LTC/DOGE, the XCHAIN debit on BTC).

501.description: Pre-flight unavailable: no indexer API is configured for this coin/network

502.description: The upstream indexer could not be reached or errored

get.description:
Dry-runs the action against the current tip inside a forced rollback and returns its validity verdict. Nothing is persisted or broadcast. `valid: null` means no verdict was produced, and the sibling flag says why: `denied` (VM actions such as DEPLOY/EXECUTE/XEXEC are not offered on this public surface, and neither is a BATCH carrying one as a sub-command, which reports the offending name in `deniedSubAction`), `feeExempt` (a settlement/lifecycle action with nothing to dry-run), `busy` (the dry-run admission window is full; retryable), or `guardInert` (the action is a controller-bound token whose guard is never entered here, so re-check on an authenticated tier). A BATCH of non-VM sub-commands IS pre-flighted, and answers `subCommands`: one verdict per sub-command, in list order. Read that rather than the batch-level `valid`, because sub-commands are not atomic. The protocol fee is settled the way `feeMode` says the real transaction will, so a payer who cannot cover an XCHAIN-settled fee is told `invalid` here rather than after paying a miner fee; `feeTokenBalance` and `feeAffordable` report that balance beside `xchainFee`. Verdicts are memoized per block height and settlement mode, so a repeat at the same tip returns `cached: true`.

The same inputs are accepted as a JSON body on **POST** to this path. Use it for anything that will not fit a query string: a 250-command BATCH (the consensus maximum) runs to roughly 17,500 characters and a GET of that size is refused with a bare 431 by the HTTP server before any handler runs. The verdict is identical either way.

post.summary: Validity-first pre-flight of an action, with the inputs in a JSON body (for batches too large for a query string)
post.description: Identical to the GET in inputs and verdict. Use it when `params` will not fit a URL, which is the case for any large BATCH: a 250-command batch is roughly 17,500 characters and a GET that size is refused with a 431 before the handler runs.

params.description: Pipe-delimited action parameters, exactly as encoded on the wire

source.description: Source address the action would be sent from

feeMode.description: How the real transaction will settle the protocol fee; omit for the chain default

413.description: Request body exceeds the pre-flight body limit

429.description: Too many pre-flight POSTs from this client

501.description: Pre-flight unavailable: no indexer API is configured for this coin/network

502.description: The upstream indexer could not be reached or errored

get.summary: Latest quorum-signed state checkpoints for this chain

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows to return; clamped server-side to 1..100

get.summary: Verify a checkpoint: 2f+1 signatures, canonical string, validator set
Quorum-signed checkpoints in a [from,to] block range (SPV forward-following)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First block height of the range, inclusive

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last block height of the range, inclusive; must be >= from. The span is capped server-side at 500 rows

get.summary: Self-synced hub-mirror status: bootstrap state and watermark lag ({enabled:false} in externally-maintained mode)
SPV balance inclusion proof for an address/tick against the committed balances_root (height optional)
SPV locked-balance (XCHAIN_ESC) inclusion proof for an address/tick against the committed balances_root; 409 below the escrow leaf armed height (height optional)
SPV inclusion proof for an action against the committed state tree
SPV proof of the BTC validator set at a snapshot height (stakes_root; BTC-only)
SPV contract-state proof (not implemented in state_root_version 1; committed EMPTY per spec D1, returns 501)

post.summary: Read-only contract method simulation (the platform's eth_call): runs a method in a sandboxed xchain-vm against current state and discards all effects; nothing is ever committed on-chain. Default-off (EXPLORER_VM_QUERY_ENABLED) and rate-limited, because every call burns real CPU in a VM subprocess.

method.description: Contract method name (wire limit: 64 bytes; no | or ; delimiter characters)

params.description: Method parameters as strings (wire limit: at most 32 entries of at most 1024 bytes each; no | delimiter)

caller.description: Simulated caller address. Defaults to a synthetic non-address marker (eth_call-from-zero semantics), so a permissioned branch sees "not the admin" unless a real caller is supplied

413.description: Contract state exceeds the simulation size limit

429.description: Too many concurrent simulations (globally or from this client); retry shortly

coin.name: COIN
coin.description: Chain + network: BTC/LTC/DOGE mainnet; T prefix = testnet, R prefix = regtest

data.description: Result rows (fields vary per endpoint; amounts are decimal strings)

ObjectResponse.description: Single result object (fields vary per endpoint; amounts are decimal strings)

NetworkAsset.description: A coin or token identity with its quoted prices (decimal strings).

usd.description: Price in USD, decimal string ("0.00" when no market)

NetworkResponse.description: Network statistics for one coin: indexer tip, mempool depth, per-action-type record counts, fee tiers, coin/XCHAIN identity and prices, and recommended finality depths.

network.description: This coin's indexer tip. `block` is the height the dashboard checkpoint-stall alert reads.

time.description: Unix time of the tip block (0 when the chain is empty)

unconfirmed.description: Mempool depth from the decoder DB (0 when unreachable)

totals.description: Exact record count per action table, keyed by table name

fee.description: Suggested fee tiers in sat/vByte from this coin's encoder

finality.description: Recommended confirmation depth per chain (display guidance, never a gate)

runtime.description: Server-side render time, present on every JSON response

checkpoints.description: Quorum-signed state checkpoints (fields vary per row; chain indices are decimal strings)

mirror_bootstrapped.description: Self-synced hub mirror has completed its initial bootstrap (present only on /checkpoints)

mirror_lag_seconds.description: Age of the mirror watermark (present only on /checkpoints)

data.description: Matching rows for TYPE (empty on the untyped /search/{QUERY} form, which returns totals only)

totals.description: Match count per category, independent of which TYPE (if any) was requested

ContractCallResponse.description: Result of a read-only contract method simulation. Nothing here was committed on-chain.

success.description: Whether the simulated method completed without an on-chain-equivalent revert

error.description: Revert/error message when success is false; null otherwise

gasUsed.description: Gas consumed under the display-only gas schedule (informational; never fee-charged)

returnValue.description: The method's return value; shape depends on the contract

logs.description: Log/event entries the simulated call emitted

simulation.description: Disclosed would-be effects; nothing here was committed on-chain.

note.description: Fixed disclaimer: "read-only preview; nothing was committed on-chain"

stateChanges.description: Contract state keys the call would have written

stateDeletes.description: Contract state keys the call would have deleted

emittedActions.description: Cross-chain/emission actions the call would have queued

action.description: The action as classified, after alias resolution

coin.description: Host chain the verdict was computed on

supported.description: Whether the action handler actually ran (independent of native-fee support)

valid.description: Would the action be accepted at the current tip; null when no verdict was produced

status.description: Verdict status from the dry-run ("valid", or the rejecting status)

error.description: Why the action would be rejected; null when valid

guardInert.description: The controller guard was not entered, so the verdict is inconclusive

denied.description: Action is not offered on this public surface (VM actions)

feeExempt.description: Settlement/lifecycle action with no dry-runnable verdict

busy.description: Dry-run admission window full; retry shortly

cached.description: Served from the block-height-keyed verdict memo

note.description: Explanatory text accompanying a no-verdict response

xchainFee.description: Protocol fee the action would owe, XCHAIN-denominated decimal string (8dp); null when the run staged no fee record, absent on no-verdict responses

feeMode.description: Fee settlement mode the verdict was computed under

feeTick.description: Ticker the protocol fee is denominated in (the gas token)

feeTokenBalance.description: Payer balance of feeTick at the quoted height, decimal string (8dp); null when it could not be read

feeAffordable.description: Whether feeTokenBalance covers xchainFee; null in native mode (the fee is not paid from that balance) or when either input is unknown

blockIndex.description: Tip height the verdict was computed against (a JSON number here, not a decimal string)

blockTime.description: Unix timestamp of that block, used for the dry-run

subCommands.description: BATCH only: each sub-command's own verdict, in list order. Sub-commands are not atomic, so the batch-level `valid` does not tell a composer which of them will settle.

action.description: Sub-command action name, after alias resolution

status.description: This sub-command's own verdict status ("valid", or the rejecting status); null when the handler recorded none

refused.description: Set instead of a status when the sub-command was never dispatched (a VM-reaching action is not run on this public surface); null otherwise

oracleFeesOwed.description: BATCH only: total oracle usage fee owed per oracle address, summed over the batch's Mode B DISPENSER sub-commands. Disclosed so a composer can size the outputs; not part of the verdict.

CoinUnavailable.description: Coin not configured on this explorer
